name: Four EVs: SoC and kWh goals, time and guarantee survive repeated fresh app boots
Completion, disconnect, settings changes and hidden EV slots do not delete Flow targets
Graceful restart checkpoints latest kWh progress rather than an older five-minute value
Completed kWh plan does not refill merely because the app restarts while cable stays connected
Reached SoC goal is retained through restart and requires fresh SoC feedback for decisions
Completed kWh data from older versions stays completed until an observed new connection
Only explicit clear deletes a plan; zero kWh remains a completed Flow goal after restart
Newest Flow goal replaces the previous kind and remains the only active source after restart
Rolling deadlines across midnight/DST and repeated feedback do not remove the saved goal
